kind_of_no: price + presence (private, no rate and no live presence anywhere)
why: Private campground beside the Gross Hill Barn bar/antique store at 40426 North Shore Road, Lake Byron. Its only listings are the city's camping page (huronsd.gov/172/Camping, read 2026-11-22: '46 camping sites with full hookups: water, sewer, 50 amp electrical. For reservations, call 605-350-2050') and a tourism-association member directory (sdglaciallakes.com/directory/gross-hill-lake-byron, read 2026-11-22: '26 full service hook-ups available'). Neither posts a rate; there is no website (grosshill.com is an unrelated domain now parked for sale at HugeDomains), no booking engine, no RV Life record (Algolia name and Lake Byron bounding-box queries both return 0, 2026-11-22), and the only Google place is 'Gross Hill Barn' categorised Bar, 4.7/30, unclaimed, no phone and no website, newest visible reviews 7-8 years old (gm 2026-11-22). Fails both private indicators (price and presence), the 5842 precedent.
name: Gross Hill Campground at Lake Byron
flags: The two official-ish sources disagree on size (46 vs 26 full-hookup sites) and neither says whether sites are sold by the night or by the season; Lake Byron is a cabin/seasonal lake, so the long-stay tests are also unmeasured.

Esri imagery 2026-11-22 at the Census geocode of the address (44.57799,-98.13803) and the Google bar pin (44.57882,-98.13463) shows the barn/farmstead north of North Shore Road and no visible block of 26-46 RV pads; a strip of shoreline units along North Shore Road about 1 km east could be it but was not identified as the campground. Not pinned.
If AWH knows it sells nights, a phone call to 605-350-2050 is the only route to a price; not made (no-calls limit).
